text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival is coming up soon!
To entertain the fans who cheer them on, the Umamusume put on events and competitions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista, who always talked about wanting to meet her fans' expectations, was naturally pumped up as well.
And with that, the event she chose was――

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Cavalry battlllllle!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Teams of four, where three form the 'carrier' base
and one stands at the top as the 'rider'!
A wildly popular event where riders battle to steal each other's headbands—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The runner to watch this year is... first and foremost, this Umamusume!
Buuuueeeenaviiistaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Just listen to this thunderous roar...!
A massive hit in the media, too!
Here is the Umamusume sprinting straight to the pinnacle of our era!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's an event I'm not used to, but I'll give it everything I've got! Everyone, please cheer me on just as loud as you would in a race!

text_block_list.name: Unicalize
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista.
Thank you for accepting my invitation.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Likewise!
Being on a team with all of you... makes me so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's team consists of Unicaliser,
At the Crest, and Shindo Runrun...
the girls who made their Make Debut alongside her.

text_block_list.name: At the Crest
text_block_list.text:
Sansha Sangyo couldn't participate
because of injury rehab, but...
she said she came to cheer us on.

text_block_list.name: Shindo Runrun
text_block_list.text:
"Our 'rider'...
could be none other than you, the star of the moment.
Let us depart with joyous hearts."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Let's have some fun—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooooooah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, welcomed with wild enthusiasm!
Another contender to watch—
Vooooodkaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The rule-breaking queen who claimed a glorious victory in last year's Japan Cup!
Now, she steps onto the stage for the cavalry battle!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haah... Alright, you lot!
Are your engines warmed up!?

text_block_list.name: Team Vodka A
text_block_list.text: Well, she's not a "guy"... but if Vodka-chan is the "rider", it's a guaranteed win, right? Let's go all out on the offensive~

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooooh...!?
To think a showdown between Vodka and Buena Vista would happen here...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I really wanted to see it!
Who's the strongest queen!? I'm so hyped!!
choice_data_list: (This heat is just like a race...)
(The excitement feels just like a race...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while reasoning calmly, my heart was racing just
like everyone else's around us. Vodka and
Buena Vista—these two were facing off—
choice_data_list: (This matchup is an absolute dream come true...!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And here it begins once again, the cavalry battle!
An event that demands teamwork, mental fortitude, and raw power...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Slam hard and take what's yours!
We are... the rowdy roughnecks!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"As expected, this team made the first move!
With an ultra-aggressive style,
they're taking down horse-mounts one after another!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Unicalize-san,
you're leaning forward a bit too much!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
At the Crest-san, Shindo Runrun-san too!
Please get ready to accelerate!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: ACKNOWLEDGED!!!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: And on the other side, Team Buena Vista! Despite a slow start, their brilliant teamwork is steadily reducing their rivals' numbers as well!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Team Vodka! Team Buena Vista!
Team Vodka! Team Buena Vista!
...It's a complete lockout, a clash of the top two!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two teams in peak form—
finally faced off against each other!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Yo, Buena. I knew that someday...
we'd have to battle it out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—I leave no openings.
Come at me with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-chan, I...
I truly respect you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Cool, with such an unyielding spirit...
Common sense has no bearing on you at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why I want to surpass you, Vodka-chan...!
—I'm coming at you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. Yeah.
If you're going that far... then I'll give it my all too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Now then—let's make it a fair fight!

text_block_list.name: Buena & Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"—Taaaaah...!
—Uoraaaah...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Two racehorses heading straight for each other.
And the outcome is—"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—A showdown driving the fans into absolute frenzy!
The victor is... Vodka! The victory goes to Vodka!
Vodka has wrestled down the next era to claim it her own!!!
choice_data_list: What in the world is happening right now...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka managed to dodge Buena by a hair's breadth.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Don't go moving so well on me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so sorry, everyone.
If only I had thought through the strategy a bit more...

text_block_list.name: Shindo Runrun
text_block_list.text: Nay, nay. We should rather praise Vodka's sheer tenacity for managing to dodge it right there.

text_block_list.name: At the Crest
text_block_list.text: Man, she's as amazing as ever... But we kept up with her right until the end! Second place is great, we did good!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaaa!
Great job out there--! You gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
Thank you so much for watching over me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite the loss, seeing Buena Vista give it
her all seemed to make her even more
popular with the fans.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista!! It's Buena Vista!!
She breaks through the seemingly unshakable Vodka!
Taking advantage of the opening with a surprise strike! An incredible victorrrrry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!! They got meee!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... If only I had moved
just 0.1 seconds faster...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Vodka-chan!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Buena…… you're just insane.
I can't believe you actually charged straight in……!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you scared?
Going all out like that against me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm not scared, you know? What's scarier is
holding anything back against Vodka-chan!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, I see.
Hey, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I lost today, but... when the real deal comes around, I ain't lettin' you pass me for the life of me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyooone...!
Thank you so much for cheering on
'Team Gorgeous Debutants'...!
choice_data_list: (It sounded like the name of an old-school idol...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is enveloped in thunderous applause.
Having thrilled the audience, her popularity...
seemed to soar even higher.
